facts.activity_file: proving dead and testing for zero energy

control_failures.control_label: proving zero energy before intrusive work

facts.title: high potential incident during an intrusive maintenance task on TX-7001

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the proving zero energy before intrusive work on TX-7001 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in applying and verifying an isolation, specifically proving dead and testing for zero energy. TX-7001 (terminal switchgear) is in service for terminal distribution. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the proving zero energy before intrusive work was not in place. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 13 May 2022 a high potential incident was recorded on TX-7001 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during an intrusive maintenance task; electrical energy held as HV switchgear was not released.
